formal_statement: ∀ T : ℕ → Set ((Fin 5 → Bool) → Bool), (∀ i : Fin 5, (fun x : Fin 5 → Bool => x i) ∈ T 0) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (f : (Fin 5 → Bool) → Bool), f ∈ T k → f ∈ T (k + 1)) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (f g : (Fin 5 → Bool) → Bool), f ∈ T k → g ∈ T k → (fun y : Fin 5 → Bool => f y && g y) ∈ T (k + 1) ∧ (fun y : Fin 5 → Bool => f y || g y) ∈ T (k + 1)) → (fun z : Fin 5 → Bool => (z 0 && z 1) || (z 1 && z 2) || (z 2 && z 3) || (z 3 && z 4) || (z 4 && z 0)) ∈ T 3
plain_statement: Is there, for the 5-cycle on inputs 0..4 (edges 01, 12, 23, 34, 40), a monotone formula of depth at most 3 for the function true exactly when both ends of some edge are true? A monotone formula: a tree of fan-in-two AND and OR gates over the inputs, no NOT, no constants; depth at most d is said as: the function lies in level d of every family of sets of functions that holds the inputs at level 0, keeps each level in the next, and puts the AND and the OR of two level-k functions in level k + 1. Conjecture.
title: Probe: Search: a monotone fan-in-two AND/OR formula of depth at most 3 for the edge function of the 5-cycle
